reason: My regulars and Google reviews fill the place already, and I am standing at the counter from morning to night, so I will not be shooting reels or approving posts on WhatsApp every Monday. It is good that there are no coupons, but I don't see why a café like mine needs Instagram.
objection: I don't believe Instagram views turn into people walking in. A free month is fine, but after that it is another ₹999 going out every month, and I won't see it show up in my evening UPI settlements.
would_change_my_mind: If another darshini or café near me showed me their UPI numbers going up after using it, I would try the free month.
